title: 第十五章 本命剑雏形气海境三重第十六章 我想和你试试
content_zh:
第十五章：本命剑雏形，气海境三重两道剑气在苏命气海之内翻飞，如同两条游蛇，轻灵而敏捷。
但只有苏命能感受到，这两道看似普通的剑气之中蕴含着多么可怕的杀伤力。
在苏命控制下，两道剑气朝着通幽玄金飞掠而去。
随后，他按照自己的想法，开始雕琢自身的本命剑。
每伴随着剑气一次闪过，通幽玄金身上的铁锈都会被震落几分，随着无数次剑气闪过，玄金的表面变得越发光滑，玄金也露出了它本身自有的光华。
那是极致的红色，红色之中，又带着些许的黑芒。
半个时辰后。
玄金已只剩下原来的三分之一大小，剑气将其打磨成了棍状模样。
一个时辰后。
玄金已初具剑的雏形，虽说后半部分还是棍状，但剑尖已经打磨出来，散发着逼人的锋芒。
丝毫不用怀疑，这要是刺一下，那绝对能造成巨大的伤害。
不同于别的法宝还需要认主，本命剑刚刚打磨出雏形，苏命已经能感觉到，自身和它建立了一股淡淡的联系。
此外，在不停地打磨本命剑后，苏命还感觉到体内的两道剑气似乎也变得更加浑厚了一些。
但与此同时！外界。
一条墨绿色的巨蟒缓缓向着苏命靠近。
它看向苏命的目光冰冷而贪婪，蛇信在空中不断吐露着。
苏命也察觉到了异常。
他猛地睁眼，下一刻双眸一缩。
“这就来了吗？”
眼前的巨蟒散发着恐怖的威势，那是实打实的三阶威压。

这条巨蟒，正是苏命任务中要解决的妖兽。
巨蟒也在打量着眼前的苏命，强大的妖兽都有自己的领地，而它已经是这幽暗密林外围最强大的妖兽。
它不明白，眼前这个弱小的蝼蚁为什么敢闯入自己的领地。
看着巨蟒，苏命心中的震惊很快消失，转而变得跃跃欲试。
一直以来，他还没使出过全力，眼前的巨蟒，正是最好的练手对象。
巨蟒终于失去了对苏命的耐性，总之，踏入它的领地就该死。它张开血盆大口，一口咬向苏命。
也是在这一刻，苏命动了。
他的身形在原地消失，随后抽出长剑，一剑刺向巨蟒。
一剑之下，九道金色剑芒瞬间迸发。
看着那九道剑芒，巨蟒眼中露出拟人化的恐惧。
直觉告诉他，这剑芒极为恐怖。
生物的本能下，它转身就逃。
可它的速度再快，又怎么可能快过剑气？
九道剑芒相继斩过，只听得“噗通”一声，巨蟒那沉重的身躯重重倒在地上，死得不能再死。
“这……这是三阶妖兽？”苏命一脸诧异。
妖兽因为其生存的环境更加恶劣，因此，它本身的战力其实比起同境界的金丹修士要强了不少。
可现在，他只是使出九截剑，就轻易将其给杀了？
“你这套剑诀本身就很强，加上那妖兽只知道逃命没有反抗，因此被你一剑斩杀也很正常。”死神塔内，白玄清的声音淡淡响起。
“原来是这样！”苏命喃喃自语：“我就说三阶妖兽怎么会这么弱。”
content_en:
Chapter 15: The prototype of the natal sword, the third level of Qi Sea Realm. Two sword qi flew in the Su Ming Qi Sea, like two swimming snakes, light and agile.
But only Su Ming could feel the terrifying lethality contained in these two seemingly ordinary sword energies.
Under Su Ming's control, the two sword energies flew towards Tongyou Xuanjin.
Then, he began to carve his own natal sword according to his own ideas.
With each flash of sword energy, the rust on Tongyou Xuanjin's body will be shaken off a bit. With countless flashes of sword energy, the surface of Xuanjin becomes smoother, and Xuanjin also reveals its own brilliance.
It was the ultimate red, with a bit of black light in the red.
Half an hour later.
Xuan Jin was only one-third of its original size, and the sword energy polished it into a stick shape.
An hour later.
Xuanjin has begun to take shape as a sword. Although the back half is still in the shape of a stick, the tip of the sword has been polished and exudes a compelling edge.
There is no doubt that if it were stabbed, it would definitely cause huge damage.
Unlike other magic weapons that still require identification of the owner, the natal sword has just been polished into its prototype, and Su Ming can already feel that he has established a faint connection with it.
In addition, after constantly polishing his natal sword, Su Ming also felt that the two sword energies in his body seemed to have become thicker.
But at the same time! outside world.
A dark green giant python slowly approached Su Ming.
It looked at Su Ming with cold and greedy eyes, and the snake's letter kept pouring out in the air.
Su Ming also noticed something unusual.
He opened his eyes suddenly and shrank the next moment.
"Is this coming?"
The giant python in front of him exudes terrifying power, which is a real third-level pressure.
This giant python is the monster that Su Ming wants to deal with in his mission.
The giant python was also sizing up Su Ming in front of him. Powerful monsters had their own territories, and it was already the most powerful monster outside the dark forest.
It didn't understand why the weak ant in front of it dared to break into its territory.
Looking at the giant python, Su Ming's shock quickly disappeared and he became eager to try.
He has never used his full strength before, and the giant python in front of him is the best training target.
The giant python finally lost its patience with Su Ming. In short, anyone who stepped into its territory would be damned. It opened its huge mouth and bit into Su Ming.
It was also at this moment that Su Ming moved.
His figure disappeared on the spot, then he drew out his long sword and stabbed the giant python with one sword.
With one strike of the sword, nine golden sword lights burst out instantly.
Looking at the nine sword rays, the giant python showed anthropomorphic fear in its eyes.
His intuition told him that this sword light was extremely terrifying.
Due to biological instinct, it turned around and ran away.
But no matter how fast it is, how can it be faster than the sword energy?
Nine rays of sword light slashed through one after another, and there was only a "pop" sound, and the giant python's heavy body fell heavily to the ground, dead.
"This...is this a third-order monster?" Su Ming looked surprised.
Because the monster beast lives in a harsher environment, its own combat power is actually much stronger than that of the Golden Core cultivators of the same realm.
But now, he just used the nine-section sword and killed him easily?
"Your sword technique itself is very strong, and the monster only knows how to run for its life without resisting, so it is normal for it to be killed by your sword." Bai Xuanqing's voice sounded faintly in the Tower of Death.
"So that's how it is!" Su Ming murmured to himself: "I just asked how the third-level monster could be so weak."
